sources.title: RSC microscale aspirin synthesis
sources.paraphrase: Primary method specifies0.23g SA,25 drops anhydride, one drop85% phosphoric acid,70–80C bath15min, filtration and ethanol/water recrystallization, with hood and splash protection. Added delivery-mass, cooling/quench and own-assay controls remain explicit author adaptations.

sources.title: RSC microscale aspirin analysis
sources.paraphrase: Free SA responds to Fe(III) with a coloured complex; primary teacher/student sheets use0.1mol/L iron(III) nitrate, standards and ethanol/water. Damp tablets/analytical hydrolysis can alter free-SA inference. The current own-product timed volumetric protocol is an explicit adaptation.

sources.title: RSC aspirin melting
sources.paraphrase: Pure aspirin reference138–140C; crude product can melt126–132C and include water, acids, starting material or other contaminants. Melting is supportive rather than exhaustive purity evidence.
